Definition: Autonomous Drone Navigation System
Above Ground Level - altitude measured from ground surface
Automotive Safety Integrity Level - ISO 26262 safety classification
Certificate of Authorization - FAA approval for drone operations
Concept of Operations - describes system usage in operational environment
Software Considerations in Airborne Systems and Equipment Certification
Extended Kalman Filter - state estimation algorithm for nonlinear systems
Federal Aviation Administration - US aviation regulatory authority
Failure Modes and Effects Analysis - systematic failure analysis method
Frames Per Second - video/image processing rate
Global Positioning System - satellite navigation system
Hardware-in-the-Loop - testing with real hardware and simulated environment
Inertial Measurement Unit - sensor measuring acceleration and rotation
Light Detection and Ranging - distance measurement using laser pulses
Mean Time Between Failures - reliability metric
Robot Operating System 2 - middleware for robotics software
Risk Priority Number - FMEA risk metric (Severity × Occurrence × Detection)
Requirements Traceability Matrix - maps requirements to design and tests
Simultaneous Localization and Mapping - algorithm for building maps while localizing
Stakeholder Requirements Specification - captures stakeholder needs
System Requirements Specification - defines system-level requirements
Unmanned Aerial Vehicle - aircraft without human pilot onboard
Visual-Inertial Odometry - motion estimation using camera and IMU
